title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono watch preview of Raga | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono watched a preview of the Ravi Shankar documentary Raga on 22 November 1971.

The screening was held at the Carnegie Hall Cinema at Carnegie Hall in New York City. Raga was directed by Howard Worth and produced by Apple Films, and featured George Harrison in several scenes.

Page last updated: 5 March 2026
